rows: Index polygons are open indicative extents organised through the HMLR INSPIRE dataset.
Dataset metadata does not prove a specific downloaded authority file.
The current INSPIRE publication is dated 5 July 2026 and authority downloads are listed.
Catalogue presence does not prove archive bytes or a successful exact match.
HMLR GML guidance identifies British National Grid EPSG:27700 workflows.
Reprojection and geometry repair still require explicit provenance.
The official bare-earth composite is available via WCS in EPSG:27700 with published ±0.15m RMSE source accuracy.
Metadata does not prove current candidate response bytes.
The official 2m DTM provides a resolution-sensitivity crosscheck.
It cannot replace the pinned DTM1m primary metric.
EA documents the persistent WCS 2.0.1 endpoint.
Requested/final endpoint and response bytes still need run receipts.
Terrain 50 is a regular 50m DTM product supplied by geographic tile.
It is a coarse secondary crosscheck.
Grid data is supplied in ASCII Grid and GML across 10km tiles.
Documentation does not validate local archive identity.
Grid rows contain 200 pixels and GML supplies location, spacing and vertical-reference metadata.
Header, orientation and companion files must be observed together.
Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI/INSPIRE conventions.
Metadata must be hash-bound to the exact tile generation.
Grid and contour products are supplied as compressed geographic tiles.
Multiple editions of one tile must not be mixed.
WCS binds coverage discovery, domain and range retrieval.
Clients must verify selected coverage, domain, axes, range and service identity.
The WCS extension permits explicit interpolation control.
Spatial relations distinguish interior, boundary and exterior semantics.
A covers result is not the same as strict interior containment.
Python JSON encoding defaults to allow_nan=true.
Strict receipts must explicitly reject non-standard NaN and Infinity.
Subprocess APIs expose timeouts and exit codes.
Parent timeout handling does not by itself prove descendant cleanup.
Resolved paths can remove parent components and resolve symlinks before containment checks.
Lexical path joins alone are insufficient.
Callers must sanitize member names and account for decompression bombs.
A file-count limit alone does not bound extracted work.
Streaming is the recommended approach for bounded downloads and timeout is not a total-download deadline.
Reading response.content first defeats a pre-buffer byte cap.
Response URL, redirects, headers and stream controls are observable.
Every redirect hop and final scheme/host must be validated.
Fiona exposes layers, features, schema and CRS for vector datasets.
The caller must impose feature and geometry resource budgets.
Raster datasets expose band count, dtype, affine transform and nodata.
Reading band zero alone does not prove the expected elevation schema.
Mask behavior depends on transform, shapes, all_touched and band indexes.
Grid orientation and selected band remain acceptance inputs.
make_valid can change geometry type and can return a GeometryCollection.
Repair must be bounded and accompanied by topology/area provenance.
